name: vibe-techdesign
title_zh: 把模糊想法变成可执行的技术设计文档
tagline_zh: 当你说“怎么搭”时，它不甩术语，而是先问清目标，再给出架构、选型和步骤。适合还在MVP阶段、不想被过度设计绑架的你。
tagline_en: When you say 'how should I build this,' it asks what matters first, then hands you a lean architecture, stack.
desc_en: Create a Technical Design Document for your MVP. Use when the user wants to plan architecture, choose tech stack, or says "plan technical design", "choose tech stack", or "how should I build this".
why_zh: 它用对话式引导替代模板填空，先对齐业务目标再谈技术，避免常见的设计文档变成自嗨。每次输出都带取舍理由。
why_en: It replaces blank-template torture with a dialogue that pins down your real constraints first, then justifies every tech.
